references.text: Direct continuation of the same dialogue and event (Shechem and his father offer marriage to become one people).
Thematic contrast between human integration (Gen 34) and divine covenant restoration (Ezek).
Parallel structure (live with + be a people) contrasting human compromise with divine covenant relationship.
Direct continuation of the same event where the invitation is extended from marriage to land and property.
Reveals the underlying motivation (greed) behind the offer to become one people.
Theological contrast between human 'becoming one people' (Gen 34) and God's holy gathering in Jerusalem.
